response: Saved Views is available today, giving every team a faster way to work with lists. Instead of rebuilding filters, sorts, and grouping options each time you open a project, you can now save the exact configuration you want and return to it in a single click. Saved Views is included in all paid plans, so there's no add-on to purchase and no extra setup required beyond turning it on. Each user can save up to 50 views, covering everything from daily priorities to quarterly planning boards, sprint backlogs, and client-specific dashboards. Once you've built a view worth keeping, you can share it with your team so everyone sees the same filtered, sorted, and grouped list without recreating it themselves. This makes onboarding new teammates easier and keeps reporting consistent across the organization. Whether you manage a small team or coordinate across multiple departments, Saved Views helps cut down repetitive setup work and keeps everyone aligned on what matters most. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
